Question 10
?

What is the general solution to the equation 5csc⁡x+10=0? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=π3+2nπ,x=7π6+2nπ
b
x=π3+2nπ,x=2π3+2nπ
c
x=π6+2nπ,x=11π6+2nπ
d
x=π6+2nπ,x=7π6+2nπ
e
x=7π6+2nπ,x=11π6+2nπ
Submit
